title: Detailed lighthouse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- night sky lit in deep purple (Doot's dark colors become glowing purple) -->
  <!-- sea -->
  <rect x='0' y='78' width='100' height='22' fill='#1a5a7a'/>
  <!-- sea highlight waves -->
  <path d='M0 82 Q10 80 20 82 T40 82 T60 82 T80 82 T100 82' stroke='#3a9aca' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M0 88 Q10 86 20 88 T40 88 T60 88 T80 88 T100 88' stroke='#3a9aca' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- foam at base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#d0f0ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- rocks -->
  <path d='M30 78 L24 70 L32 68 L38 74 L44 68 L52 72 L48 78 Z' fill='#6a6a8a'/>
  <path d='M52 78 L56 70 L64 68 L70 72 L68 78 Z' fill='#7a7aaa'/>
  <path d='M44 68 L48 72 L52 72 L52 68 Z' fill='#8a8aba'/>
  <!-- lighthouse base -->
  <rect x='42' y='52' width='16' height='22' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  <!-- red stripes -->
  <rect x='42' y='56' width='16' height='5' fill='#e83030'/>
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='16' height='5' fill='#e83030'/>
  <!-- base door -->
  <rect x='47' y='68' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#4a6a8a'/>
  <!-- top gallery -->
  <rect x='38' y='48' width='24' height='5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='38' y='48' width='24' height='2' fill='#4a4a7a'/>
  <!-- railing posts -->
  <rect x='38' y='43' width='2' height='5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='43' width='2' height='5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <!-- railing bar -->
  <rect x='38' y='43' width='24' height='1.5' fill='#4a4a7a'/>
  <!-- lantern room -->
  <rect x='44' y='34' width='12' height='14' fill='#ffe860'/>
  <!-- lantern glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#fff4a0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- lantern panes -->
  <rect x='44' y='34' width='12' height='14' fill='none' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='34' x2='50' y2='48' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='41' x2='56' y2='41' stroke='#2a2a4a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- light beams -->
  <polygon points='50,41 68,30 68,36' fill='#fff4a0' opacity='0.4'/>
  <polygon points='50,41 32,30 32,36' fill='#fff4a0' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='42,34 58,34 50,24' fill='#e83030'/>
  <!-- roof highlight -->
  <polygon points='46,32 54,32 50,27' fill='#ff6060'/>
  <!-- roof ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='23' r='2.5' fill='#ffd040'/>
  <!-- finial -->
  <line x1='50' y1='20.5' x2='50' y2='18' stroke='#ffd040' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- stars -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='15' r='1.2' fill='#c0a0ff'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='10' r='1.2' fill='#c0a0ff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='1' fill='#c0a0ff'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='25' r='1' fill='#c0a0ff'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='30' r='1' fill='#c0a0ff'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='35' r='1' fill='#c0a0ff'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='12' r='1' fill='#c0a0ff'/>
  <!-- moon -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='14' r='6' fill='#e8e0a0'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='12' r='5' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <!-- birds -->
  <path d='M60 25 Q62 23 64 25' stroke='#c0a0ff' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M66 22 Q68 20 70 22' stroke='#c0a0ff' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
</svg>
